messages:
Lina: heads up — tsukasa-v1 int4 bring-up on staging shows a weird detok/token bleed when zhuyin (bopomofo) mixes with katakana in ja/zh-tw mixed evals. quick BLEU drop on taiwan news set
Wei: can you paste a tiny repro?
Lina: short example below
Lina: ```
input: "臺北市議會で進行中的示範：ㄊㄞˊㄅㄟˇカタカナ混在"
tokenizer.tokens: ["▁臺","北","市","議","會","で","進","行","中","的","示","範","：","ㄊ","ㄞ","ˊ","ㄅ","ㄟ","ˇ","カ","タ","カ","ナ","混","在"]
model_fp16_detok: "臺北市議會で進行中的示範：ㄊㄞˊㄅㄟˇカタカナ混在"
model_int4_detok: "臺北市議会で進行中的示范: ㄊㄞˊㄅㄟˇカタカナ混在"

notes: int4 output merged some han+kana boundaries and swapped diacritics.
```
Samir: that token sequence looks like combining marks (ˊ ˇ) are getting attached to previous token differently under the quantized path. could be tokenizer normalization or a tokenmap offset shift during compilation.
Noah: did we use the exact same tokenizer artifact between fp16 and int4?
Lina: yes — tokenizer v2.3 both. difference only introduced at quantize->compile step where we run the kernel selection / qconfig pipeline.
Wei: can you share the compiled qconfig used? maybe qk_scale or per-channel vs per-tensor quant caused a different tokenization postprocess?
Lina: compiled qconfig: `qbits=4, group_size=128, per_channel=true, qk_scale=0.85` (this is what we used for the tsukasa-int4 canary)
Samir: interesting. I've seen combining mark handling flip when the detok code relies on byte offsets that assume no tokenmap shifts. quantized kernels sometimes change padding/pack ordering which can shift offsets.
Samir: quick thing to try: run tokenizer debug dump and the runtime detok with explicit unicode normalization (NFC vs NFD).
Samir: ```bash
python -c "from tokenizer import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.load('v2.3').debug('臺北市議會で進行中的示範：ㄊㄞˊ'))"
```
QA Bot: Repro job queued 987654 — dataset: taiwan-bnews-zh-tw (10k lines), seed=42, model=tsukasa-v1:int4. Will post metrics to thread when done.
Wei: in parallel I can run the tiny loki script to diff fp16 vs int4 tokenmaps for the first 1k lines.
Lina: thanks. Initial smoke: BLEU_FP16=28.3; BLEU_INT4=24.5 (delta -3.8) on the sample subset.
Noah: as a short-term mitigation, we can route zh-tw locale traffic to tsukasa-v1:int8. I'll create a per-locale alias and canary it. Want me to flip it to 100% for zh-tw until we root cause?
Lina: yes please — prefer int8 for zh-tw until we confirm fix. Also log RNW-3421 created.
Noah: created alias `tsukasa-v1:zh-tw -> tsukasa-v1:int8` and canaried 100% for locale=zh-tw. Applied policy at 4054322200.
Samir: I'll bisect quant params: group_size, per_channel, qk_scale, and also try `qk_scale=1.0` fallback. Might reveal threshold where combining marks move.
Wei: another quick experiment — try eval with `--detok-compat=zhuyin` and `USE_KVCACHE=false` to see if kv cache packing interacts.
Samir: command to run for repro
Samir: ```bash
./eval_tool --model tsukasa-v1:int4 --dataset taiwan-bnews-zh-tw --seed 42 --lines 1000 --detok-compat zhuyin --no-kv-cache --debug-tokenmap > /tmp/tsukasa_int4_debug.out
```
Lina: QA Bot posted interim: job 987654 finished — BLEU_INT4=24.6, example diffs attached in artifact 987654:logs (see tokenmap diff).
QA Bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/987654/tsukasa_int4_token_diffs.tar.gz
Wei: grabbing artifact now.
Noah: side note — deploy-bot shows the int4 canary succeeded in staging without infra errors. Not a runtime crash, purely quality.
deploy-bot: deploy tsukasa-v1:int4 -> staging successful at 4054322100 :white_check_mark:
Samir: if bisect points to `group_size` as culprit we can try group_size=64; if it's per_channel=false then we may need to rebuild quant pipeline.
Lina: thx all. Action items: 1) Samir bisect quant params and post smallest reproducer (1-5 examples) 2) Wei run tokenmap diff and check unicode normalization 3) Noah keep zh-tw routing on int8 4) Lina will document in RNW-3421 and follow-up with writeup.
Noah: done on routing, and added runbook note under /runbooks/lang-fallbacks.md
Lina: I'll follow up with a short summary once Samir and Wei have results. :thumbsup:
